scene: The key unlocks three hidden transit portals along the canal workshop dock.
picture: A flat side view along the wooden canal dock. On the left, a sleek bento express train waits on shiny tracks. In the centre, the grandfather stands holding his bicycle with its crate of plants. Up high overhead, a mossy garden tram rests on a wire. On the far right waits a retro green streetcar.
shown: a sleek red bullet train carriage with steam vents on the left
a moss-roofed sky tram hooked to an overhead cable up high
a glowing green streetcar waiting on rails at the far right
